items.title: Hal ki jaanch aur behtari (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Evaluating and Improving Solutions (PDF 26, printed 22).

blocks.text: Hal (solution) mil jane ke baad us ka evaluation (jaanch) zaroori hai. Evaluation se hum check karte hain ke hal sahi hai ya nahi. Is se hum ghaltiyan dhoond kar theek kar sakte hain. Hal ko test karne se pata chalta hai ke woh theek kaam karta hai ya nahi. Hum hal ko aur aasan ya tez bana kar behtar kar sakte hain. Yeh amal hamein ghaltiyon se seekhna sikhata hai. Hal ko behtar karne se performance (kaam ki karkardagi) behtar hoti hai. Evaluation masla hal karne ka aham hissa hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Evaluation ke chaar kaam yaad rakhein: check (kya hal sahi hai?), test (kya amal mein chalta hai?), fix (ghalti theek karo), improve (hal ko aasan ya tez banao).

blocks.prompt: Figure 2.2 ka chai wala algorithm test kiya gaya aur chai pesh karte waqt thandi thi. Aap pehle kaun sa step check karenge, aur algorithm kaise behtar ho sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Pani ubalne aur chai pesh karne ke darmiyan ke steps check karein: ho sakta hai patti zyada der bhigoyi gayi aur pani thanda ho gaya, ya doodh thanda tha. Behtari: patti bhigone ka waqt likh dein (maslan do teen minute) aur doodh garam karne ka step jor dein, taake har dafa ek jaisa nateeja aaye.

items: Hal milne ke baad evaluation zaroori hai: check, test, fix, improve.
Evaluation ghaltiyon se seekhata hai aur behtar performance deta hai.
